    The presentation criterion for tau-rigidity #

    source
    def EFiniteCharacterizations.IsTauRigid (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (M : FGModuleCat R) :
    Prop

    A module is tau-rigid when its Hom to the Auslander–Reiten translate vanishes. The translate is the Nakayama kernel of a minimal projective presentation.
